# `OpenApiBridgeFactory`

`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi\OpenApiBridgeFactory`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Mcp\OpenApi`](/packages/mcp-openapi) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/mcp-openapi/blob/master/src/OpenApiBridgeFactory.php)

Builds a configured OpenApiServerConfigurator from what a consumer
actually has: a spec (file path, http(s) URL or a decoded document), a base
URL, PSR-18/PSR-17 services and the operation allow-list.

This exists so the bridge is a PACKAGE feature rather than a Yii3-application
one. `SpecIndex` and `HttpOperationExecutor` are `@internal`, so a consumer
outside `Rasuvaeff\` cannot construct them without a Psalm `InternalClass`
error it has no legal way to silence; this factory constructs both itself
and hands back the `@api` configurator, which is all
\Rasuvaeff\Mcp\McpServerFactory::create() needs. Their
constructors stay free to move.

`McpServerComponentResolver` calls this too, so the config-plugin path and a
standalone server assemble the bridge through the same code.

## Methods

### create()

```php
static create(
    array|string $spec,
    string $baseUrl,
    ?Psr\Http\Client\ClientInterface $httpClient,
    ?Psr\Http\Message\RequestFactoryInterface $requestFactory,
    Psr\Http\Message\StreamFactoryInterface $streamFactory,
    array $operations,
    array $headers,
    array $specHeaders,
    ?Psr\SimpleCache\CacheInterface $specCache,
    int $specCacheTtl,
    bool $safeMethodsOnly,
    array $toolNames,
    ?OperationModifierInterface $modifier,
    array $dryRunOperations,
    ?Identity\ExecutionIdentityProviderInterface $identityProvider,
    ?DelegatedHeaderProviderInterface $delegatedHeaderProvider,
    ?int $maxResponseBytes,
    bool $opaqueErrors,
    array $multiSegmentPathParams,
    ?Psr\Http\Server\RequestHandlerInterface $inProcessHandler,
    ?Psr\Http\Message\ServerRequestFactoryInterface $serverRequestFactory,
    ?ExecutionRequestAttributesInterface $requestAttributes,
    ?InProcessScopeInterface $inProcessScope,
    ?string $arrayQueryStyle,
    array $arrayQueryParams,
): OpenApiServerConfigurator
```

- `$httpClient` — PSR-18 client: REQUIRED for http execution and for a URL                                $spec; psr15 mode with a file/decoded spec may pass null —                                the container then needs no HTTP transport services at all
- `$requestFactory` — PSR-17 request factory, same nullability rules                                as $httpClient
- `$operations` — allow-list of operationIds to expose
- `$specCache` — PSR-16 cache for a URL $spec; ignored for a file or array
- `$specCacheTtl` — TTL for that cache; 0 fetches on every build
- `$dryRunOperations` — operationIds that get a `dryRun` boolean argument
- `$maxResponseBytes` — upstream body cap; null uses the package default
- `$inProcessHandler` — selects in-process execution: the application's                                own handler receives the same request the HTTP executor would                                send, without network I/O; null (default) keeps real HTTP calls
- `$serverRequestFactory` — required together with $inProcessHandler
- `$requestAttributes` — maps the resolved ExecutionIdentity                                to request attributes on the nested request (in-process only)
- `$inProcessScope` — enter()/leave() hooks around the nested handle()                                for resetting request-scoped state (in-process only)
- `$arrayQueryStyle` — default serialization of array-valued query parameters:                                'repeat' (name=a&name=b), 'brackets' (name[]=a&name[]=b) or 'comma'                                (name=a,b); null derives it from the parameter's declared explode
